title: Daily Well-being & Environment Check-in
description: Adaptive check-in that conditionally reveals questions on-device and generates a researcher follow-up post-submission.

notification_prompt.title: Daily Well-being Check-in
notification_prompt.body: Please take a moment to record your current well-being and surroundings.

adaptive_followup.researcher_prompt: You are an empathetic behavioral health researcher. Based on the participant's stress score, free-text mood explanation, and current surroundings photo, formulate exactly ONE thoughtful follow-up question to probe what environmental or interpersonal factors contributed most to their current state.

questions.prompt: On a scale from 1 (completely calm) to 10 (extremely stressed), how stressed do you feel?
In your own words, how do you feel at the moment?
What strategy or support are you currently using to navigate this feeling?

gating_rule.natural_language_condition: The participant feels stressed or anxious

questions.prompt: Is there anything else you want to share right now?
